data.text:
Abin Jose vs The Food Safety Officer on 23 May, 2024 
Author: Bechu Kurian Thomas
Bench: Bechu Kurian Thomas
Crl.MC No.4250/2021 1/1
 In The High Court Of Kerala At Ernakulam
 Present
 The Honourable Mr. Justice Bechu Kurian Thomas
 Thursday, the 23rd day of May 2024 / 2nd Jyaishta, 1946
 Crl.M.Appl.No.1/2021 In Crl.Mc No. 4250 Of 2021
 Cc 239/2019 Of Judicial First Class Magistrate Court-Iii, Kozhikode
 Applicants/Petitioners/Petitioners/Accused Nos. 7 To 9:
 1. Abin Jose M/S. Pallipuram Agencies Big Bazar, Kozhikode 673
 001
 And 2 Others
 Respondents/Respondent, State & Another:
 1. The Food Safety Officer Kozhikode South Circle Ipd Building,
 Kottaparamba Kozhikode 673 001
 And 2 Others 
 Application praying that in the circumstances stated therein  the High Court be pleased to stay all further proceedings in  C.C. No.239 of 2019 pending on the files of the Court of the  Judicial First Class Magistrate-III, Kozhikode pending  disposal of the above Criminal Miscellaneous Case . 
 This Application again coming on for orders upon perusing the  application and this court's order dated 23/11/2023 in  Crl.M.A.1/2021 and upon hearing the arguments of Mr. PREMJIT  NAGENDRAN, Advocate for the petitioner and the PUBLIC  PROSECUTOR for R1 and R2 and of Mr. SANTHAN V.NAIR, Advocate  for R3, the court passed the following:
 ORDER Interim order shall stand extended by two months.
Sd/- BECHU KURIAN THOMAS JUDGE 23-05-2024 /True Copy/ Assistant Registrar Abin Jose vs The Food Safety Officer on 23 May, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/161770712/ 
1
